metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:embedding_collapse_score: (mean sampled off-diagonal item cosine + 1)/2; 0.5 means mean cosine zero. Not a collapse probability or accuracy metric. Null if undefined or embeddings are nonfinite.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:embedding_support: Catalog size, sampled item count, and nonfinite catalog item count; padding excluded.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_margin_mean: Scale-dependent mean positive-minus-negative score across finite nonpadding positions with both targets nonzero.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_margin_p10: Nearest-rank 10th percentile of the same margins.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate: Fraction of supported margins strictly below zero; ties are not negative wins. Not HR@10.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_small_margin_rate: Fraction of supported margins below the scale-dependent threshold 0.5.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:all_position_support: Valid positions before finite exclusions, finite comparisons, nonfinite exclusions; distinct users unavailable.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_margin_category_br: Item categories unavailable; category lists remain empty. Position totals are measured without category information.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:final_position_margins: Same margin statistics at each row's largest nonzero index, requiring both original targets nonzero. Empty summaries have null values and zero comparisons.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:row_support: Bounded loader-row counts, which can include repeated users. All-padding and missing-target rows are excluded from final comparisons.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:paired_perturbations: Means of changed-minus-baseline margins and scores on identical original targets. Recent/older delete equal disjoint sets of m=min(3,(n-1)//2), retaining the final event. Repacking left-pads survivors; embedding ablation zeros only selected input embedding outputs while preserving positions. Their difference measures intervention implementation sensitivity, not an isolated causal distance effect. Shuffle pools nonidentity comparisons across five draws; repeated rows are correlated. Null means no finite supported comparisons.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:shuffle_support_by_draw: Rows with at least two distinct prefix item values, skipped identity item permutations, and actual nonidentity draws; final event, padding, length and item multiset are preserved.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:structure: Exact offset-set propagation through both actual stride-one convolution dilations and residual unions for the supplied causal NextItNet template. Span is maximum offset plus one, distinct from reachable count. Unsupported modules invalidate offset claims. Assumes supplied forward topology; empirical checks do not prove completeness.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:operator_fault_calibration: Bounded local indexed-sum convolution reference with supplied-source dilation semantics and independently reconstructed left padding. Kernel width follows fitted tensor shape, so this is not a complete independent architecture oracle. Calibration rows at the first seeded site determine the frozen tolerance; held-out sites receive clean controls before mutations and cannot inflate it. Unsupported sites are excluded explicitly; clean mismatches stop calibration claims. Controls are separate from mutation denominators. Operator/severity summaries separate finite local comparisons, local alarms, logit alarms and tie-sensitive ordered top-10 disagreements within fixed IDs 1..min(itemnum,32). These candidates need not contain training targets; results are not HR@10. Tensor recomputation is not full checkpoint reload or deployment parity. A deliberate exception verifies temporary-hook cleanup and fixed-input output agreement only, not full execution-state restoration. Whole-block reference, synthetic primitive calibration, readout faults and held-out-family generalization remain unavailable. Rows may share users; no confidence interval or validation accuracy is inferred.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:implementation_checks: Finite checks and numerical comparisons with recorded tolerances: future changes versus features through an interior position, aligned prefix versus full features, and view versus actual-module candidate scoring. No observations means untested, not passed.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:offset_checks: Bounded input replacements at observed nonpadding offsets relative to final readout; structural row indices identify sampled rows, not users. Up to three reachable and two unreachable distances are selected per row. Missing unreachable observations mean untested, not passed. Unreachable effects beyond tolerance suggest implementation or dependency-analysis problems. No response at reachable offsets can reflect inactive nonlinearities; it does not prove irrelevance.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:configuration: Bounded first-row selection, RNG seeds, tolerances and feature dtype. Global RNG states, module modes and temporary hooks are restored. No stable user identifiers or user-level confidence intervals.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:deployment_reload_parity: Unavailable here. Requires separate host execution of generated-predictor reload on identical category routes, mappings, truncation, left padding, histories and candidates; in-memory scoring checks do not establish it.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:validation_rank_metrics: Unavailable without permitted fixed validation candidates and stable IDs. No benchmark HR@10, ranks, overlap or user bootstrap is inferred from sampled positive/negative pairs.
